handbook_blocks: | E-1001 | VPN server not reachable | Check your internet connection, then reconnect |
| E-1002 | VPN certificate expired | Renew the certificate in the self-service portal |
| E-2001 | Password older than 90 days | Choose a new password in the self-service portal |
| E-2002 | Account locked after 5 failed logins | Wait 15 minutes or call the service desk |
| E-3001 | Disk almost full | Delete old downloads or ask for more space |
| E-3002 | Backup failed | Leave the laptop on and plugged in overnight |
| E-4001 | Printer offline | Restart the printer and check its network cable |
| E-4002 | Badge not recognised by the printer | Register your badge again at the service desk |
| E-5001 | Mailbox full | Archive mails older than one year |
| E-5002 | Shared calendar not syncing | Remove the calendar and add it again |

- your badge
- the one-time password from your manager's email
- a wired network connection for the first update

meeting_topics: Anna opened the meeting with the laptop refresh. Every laptop older than four years will be replaced in March. IT will collect the old laptops and wipe their disks. Staff can keep their docking stations and monitors.

Ben then talked about the office move. The team moves to the second floor of the north building in May. Every desk on the new floor has a height-adjustable desk and two monitors. Parking permits for the north building can be requested from facilities.

Clara presented the new travel rules. Train travel is required for trips under six hours. Hotel costs are refunded up to 150 euros a night, and up to 200 euros in London and Paris. Travel receipts must reach finance within one month.

Finally, Dan reminded everyone about holiday planning. Leave for December must be requested by the end of October. Unused leave days carry over to the end of March. Sick leave still needs a doctor's note from the third day.
